bio: This restaurant located in the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district draws diners in with its chic, minimalist decor and exciting cuisine. In his Levantine-inspired creations, owner Gal Ben Moshe combines his Israeli roots with the culinary traditions of neighbouring countries such as Syria and Lebanon, among others. Made with excellent ingredients and injected with a great deal of creativity, the interesting dishes are replete with contrasts in flavour. The Near East and the whole world are represented here.
